column1: # W-HASH — string hashing, symbol interning, .bss layout, the build watermark.
# NOTE: no `crc` label appears here on purpose. JamCRC is ABSENT from c2.dll
# (see C2_MAP.md 6 P1); pattern-matching hash-shaped code near an emit site
# would have produced a confident wrong address.

column4: shift-9 xor-fold string hash: h=(h<<9)^((h>>14)&0x3fe00)^(int8_t)c; returns name[0] if fold==0
UTF-16 variant of 10b8a01b, identical fold over ushort*
CSE/value-number hash, % 0x65 (101 buckets) — this is what hash.c actually holds
sibling of 10b5a3cc in the same 101-bucket table
name->symbol intern; 128-slot open-address cache DAT_10c67db8, idx=hash&0x7f, linear probe
same 128-slot cache; creates an external symbol via 10b9b6a4
name lookup by full scan of the 1024-bucket id table (or 16001-bucket DAT_10c47af0)
insert into DAT_10c6c068: bucket = sym[10] & 0x3ff, chain at offset 0, HEAD insertion
lookup by integer id in the 1024-bucket table
monotone symbol-id counter DAT_10c2edd0++ for c2-created symbols
.bss bump allocator on DAT_10c2e320: align 8, then +(8-size) fixup for size in {1,2,4}
stores the allocated address to sym+0x18, sets first-touch done-flag 0x800
drains the deferred dyninit list head-first — the source of the .bss reversal
creates .XBLD$W and the __C2_11886 build-stamp symbol; byte-swaps 16 B LE->BE
